methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
the machine states were automatically identiﬁed using the machine learning algorithm
Gaussian Naive Bayes [17] within the Web App. Subsequently, the non-production time
factor (NPTF) is calculated, which is deﬁned as the ratio of non-production time and total
observed time [18].

paper_type.evidence_quote:
The ETAS and the presented framework are applied to a cleaning machine (Fig. 3 (a))
and a lathe (Fig. 3 (b)) within the ETA Research Factory at the Technical University
of Darmstadt.

evidence_quote: Within the same production chain, shafts are turned on the

lathe and gears are processed in the cleaning machine to be later assembled into a
gearbox.

stage1.notes: Applied at one research factory to discrete-production machines; the embedded Gaussian Naive Bayes state model and NPTF ratio constitute characterised EnPI content.
